orchestrator.description: Main engineering flow coordinator. Analyzes requests, delegates to specialist agents, and validates results.

planner.description: Creates detailed implementation plans before coding. Analyzes requirements, identifies impacted modules, and produces step-by-step plans.

architect.description: Reviews architecture decisions and system design. Validates SOLID principles, modularity, scalability, and consistency.

backend.description: Django/DRF backend engineer specializing in Python. Implements models, serializers, viewsets, permissions, and services.

code-reviewer.description: General code reviewer. Evaluates quality, security, maintainability, bugs, readability, and performance of changes.

python-reviewer.description: Python-specific code reviewer. Evaluates PEP 8, type hints, Pythonic patterns, security, and performance of Python code.

typescript-reviewer.description: TypeScript/JavaScript-specific code reviewer. Evaluates type safety, async correctness, security, and idiomatic patterns.

database-reviewer.description: PostgreSQL database reviewer. Evaluates queries, schema, indexes, migrations, RLS, performance, and security.

security-reviewer.description: Security reviewer. Detects OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, secrets, injection, auth, XSS, and insecure dependencies.

api-reviewer.description: REST and OpenAPI contract reviewer. Validates endpoints, HTTP methods, status codes, payloads, pagination, and compatibility.

tdd.description: Test-Driven Development assistant. Creates and maintains tests following RED → GREEN → REFACTOR with minimum 80% coverage.

e2e.description: E2E test runner and validator. Creates, maintains, and runs end-to-end tests with Playwright, manages artifacts and flaky tests.

documentation.description: Documentation updater. Maintains README, CLAUDE.md, API docs, and codemaps in sync with code.

build-error-resolver.description: Build and type error fixer. Resolves TypeScript compilation failures, module errors, and configuration issues with minimal changes.

production-reviewer.description: Production readiness reviewer. Validates Docker, environment variables, CI/CD, tests, logs, security, healthchecks, and configuration.
